audit_items.proof_trace: BlobRPCMinValidSlot computes minimum valid slot using DENEB_FORK_EPOCH without checking FULU_FORK_EPOCH. Post-FULU, requests for slots >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH pass validation (L199) but fail during retrieval, causing peers to be downscored (L82-83) for legitimate requests during fork transition.
audit_items.attack_scenario: At FULU activation (epoch 100), attacker requests blob sidecars for slot at epoch 100. Validation uses minStartSlot from DENEB (epoch 0), passes check, but streamBlobBatch fails (blobs don't exist post-FULU), triggering downscorePeer for valid protocol behavior.
